paragraphs: Rav Kahana son of Mattithiah, Menachot 26b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked verse lists Mattithiah among those standing beside Ezra. Hyman lists the biblical figure and the later name in separate notices.

Hyman cites Menachot 26b for Rav Kahana son of Mattithiah. The name has not been located in the consulted text of that folio. [Ohr Zarua](https://www.sefaria.org/Ohr_Zarua%2C_Volume_II.114.1) explicitly names Rav Kahana bar Mattithiah as a transmitter in a ruling about an alleyway. The same ruling in [Eruvin 8b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.8b.7) has Rav Kahana bar Minyumi at that point in the chain.
